thread:
Alice Martin: opened a docs PR for the new SDK embeddings example — small change, adds a snippet and a migration note for v2. Can someone from docs review? I want to enable auto-merge once the preview + checks pass. cc @Ben Cho @Carol Nguyen :eyes:
Ben Cho: I can take a look in ~30m. Quick Q: do we have an exemption for docs-only PRs so they can auto-merge when all CI checks are green?
Carol Nguyen: short answer: not universally. We have a label-based workflow for some repos (label: `docs-automerge`) that a bot watches. But branch protection still requires the required status checks to be green and required reviewers per CODEOWNERS.
Dave Li: FYI, CODEOWNERS currently has `/docs/ @redwood/docs-team` and `docs/sdk @eng-platform` for the snippets folder — so if your change touches `docs/sdk` it'll ping eng-platform as well.
Alice Martin: ah thanks — my change touches `docs/sdk/embeddings.md` only. How do we avoid needing an eng-platform review for tiny wording fixes?
Carol Nguyen: options: 1) move the change under a path owned only by docs, 2) update CODEOWNERS (requires PR and 1+ review from owners), or 3) ask eng-platform reviewer for a quick approve. For small edits we usually ping the reviewer with @mention and `docs: tiny` in the PR title to signal low-risk.
Ben Cho: also note the auto-merge bot only runs if the PR passes all required checks. The common blocker is the `docs-preview` check which can fail on broken links or build warnings. If that fails, nothing auto-merges.
Alice Martin: the preview failed on a relative link I missed. Fixed in a follow-up commit. Is there a way to mark the check as optional so it won't block auto-merge?
Carol Nguyen: you can mark non-critical checks as optional in branch protection, but that's an org-wide policy and we try to keep `docs-preview` required. Better pattern: make the preview faster and less strict for trivial changes, or add an override label handled by the bot (we don't currently have a safe override for link failures).
Dave Li: if this is urgent (typo or broken link in a public doc), ping `#docs` and the oncall docs reviewer. We'll do a manual merge after verifying the fix. Manual merge is what we lean on during the release shipping window to avoid surprises.
Alice Martin: what's the shipping window again? I don't want to block releases.
Carol Nguyen: we avoid automatic merges Mon-Fri 09:00-17:00 PT for the week of a major release. Outside that, automerge is allowed 00:00-23:59 but we still watch for cascading doc regressions.
Ben Cho: small procedural note — if you want the automerge label, add `label: docs-automerge` in the PR description OR apply the label via the GitHub UI. Our bot (Docs Bot) watches for that label + all required checks passing.
Docs Bot: preview built — https://deploy-preview.redwood.ai/preview/9823 (check: `docs-preview` — success)
Alice Martin: thanks! Preview looks good. I've added the `docs-automerge` label.
Ben Cho: I'll do a quick pass on the snippet. If I approve, the bot should queue it for auto-merge once the rest of checks pass.
Dave Li: one more gotcha: if CODEOWNERS requires an approval from a team that uses Protected Teams forcing 2 reviewers, automerge will wait for that. We had a recent PR stuck because `eng-platform` had 2-member review requirement.
Alice Martin: noted. For this one, only docs-team is required. Please go ahead and review, Ben.
Ben Cho: approved. :thumbsup:
Docs Bot: automerge queued (PR #5342) — waiting for: `ci/lint`, `security/snyk`
Ben Cho: `ci/lint` is flaky sometimes; if it flakes repeatedly, open an issue with CI team and add `recheck-ci` label so the bot retries.
Docs Bot: `ci/lint` passed. `security/snyk` passed. All checks green — merging now. :merge:
Alice Martin: merged, thanks everyone! :tada:
Carol Nguyen: quick follow-up — I'll draft a tiny doc about the label workflow and shipping windows so it's clear in CONTRIBUTING.md.
Alice Martin: awesome — that will help new contributors.
